## Projects
- Target-Aware Whole-Body Throwing [ml, research] — Python, MuJoCo, TD3, PPO, Unitree G1 (slug: throwing)
  Teach a Unitree G1 humanoid to hit targets at varying distances while walking, in simulation, without falling.
  The final TD3 policy landed 0.177 m from the target on average, hit 100% of targets within 0.5 m and never fell across a held-out target sweep.
  Built in July 2026 at the Audi Development Camp in Győr by a six-person, five-country team selected for the programme run by Széchenyi István University with Audi Hungaria. I was project manager and integration lead, and owned the reinforcement-learning controller. The task is staged curriculum learning: a fixed throw first, then throwing while walking, then a target that changes. Potential-based reward shaping kept each stage learnable. We benchmarked PPO against TD3 and adopted TD3 for its off-policy sample efficiency.
- CRM and project management platform [web, systems] (slug: crm)
  MAT Consultancy needed one place for customer relationships and project tracking that matched how the company works.
  An integrated CRM and project management platform, and a digital architecture that maps the company’s operations onto workflows and business objectives (Mar 2024 – Jan 2026).
- ML-driven specification management for packaging [ml, systems] (slug: specs)
  Packaging processes at MAT Consultancy needed a faster, data-driven way to manage specifications.
  An ML-driven specification management platform that optimises packaging processes.
- Feedback intelligence pipeline [ml] — NLP, web data collection (slug: feedback)
  How does the public react to the Presidency of Religious Affairs’ weekly articles, at scale?
  A data-driven pipeline that collects reactions from the web automatically and analyses them with NLP, built during an R&D internship at NETAŞ (summer 2025).
- AI agents for real-world problems [agents] (slug: agents)
  AI agents and end-to-end solutions built at Genarion (Feb – Apr 2025) as a GenAI solution architect, with a range of tools and technologies.
- This site [web] — React, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind (slug: site)
  A portfolio a recruiter can skim in 30 seconds and an engineer can drive from a shell prompt.
  Prerendered to static HTML, English and Turkish, every command works with the keyboard.
  The command bar is the only unusual thing on the page. Everything it does is also reachable by scrolling and clicking, so nobody is locked out. All copy lives in one content file. Updating the site means editing that file; the build renders it to static HTML so the page reads without JavaScript too.
- Antibacterial soap with silver nanoparticles [research] (slug: nanosoap)
  Can silver nanoparticles replace triclocarban, a harmful antibacterial agent, in soap?
  Nanotechnology research presented at the 4th National Science Congress, METU, Ankara (June 2021).
